picks.title: The Passionate Testimony of an Innocent Man, Part 2
picks.summary:
Selections from Job 29–31

Like an accused criminal with no defense attorney, Job represents himself and presents his case before his friends. He even invites an answer from his sovereign Judge.

Join Pastor Chuck Swindoll as he observes Job’s “day in court” (Job 29–31).

Job teaches us lasting lessons in his suffering. Uncover how to reflect on past blessings, pursue humility in present trials, and reaffirm your commitment to integrity.
picks.reason: A careful Bible study on Job's suffering, integrity, and humility in trials.
